{{c|''To his Disciples (by occasion of Hierusalem and the Temples destruction) he foretelleth, 4. vvhat things shalbe before the consummation of the vvorld, as specially, 14. the Churches ful preaching vnto al nations: 15. then, what shalbe in the very consummation, to vvit, Antichrist vvith his passing great persecution and seduction, but for a short time: 29. then incontinent, the Day of iudgement to our great comfort in those miseries vnder Antichrist. 35. As for the moment, to vs it perteineth not to know it, 37. but rather euery man to watch, that we be not vnprouided when he commeth to ech one particularly by death.''}} {{verse|chapter=24|verse=1}}AND {{sc|Iesvs}} being gone out of the temple, vvent. And his disciples came to shevv him the buildings of the tēple.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 13, 1. Lu. 21, 5.''}} {{verse|chapter=24|verse=2}}† And he answering said to thē, Do you see al these things? Amen I say to you, there shal {{sup|‖}} not be left here a stone vpon a stone that shal not be destroied.

{{verse|chapter=24|verse=3}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel for a votiue Masse in time of warre. and for many Martyrs.}}And vvhen he vvas sitting vpon Mount-oliuet, the disciples came to him secretly, saying: Tel vs, vvhen shal these things be? and vvhat shal be {{sup|‖}} the signe of thy comming, and of the consummation of the vvorld? {{verse|chapter=24|verse=4}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=TVESDAY night.}}And {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvering, said to them, Bevvare that no man {{sup|‖}} seduce you: {{verse|chapter=24|verse=5}}† for many shal come in my name saying, {{sup|‖}} I am Christ: and they shal seduce many. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=6}}† For you shal heare of vvarres, & bruites of vvarres. See that ye be not troubled. for these things must be done: but the end is not yet. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=7}}† for nation shal rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shal be pestilences, and famines, and earth-quakes in places, {{verse|chapter=24|verse=8}}† and al these things are the beginnings of sorovves.⊣ {{verse|chapter=24|verse=9}}† Then {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 10, 17.''}}* shal they deliuer you into tribulation, and shal kil you: and you shal be odious to al nations for my names sake. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=10}}† And then many shal be scandalized: and they shal deliuer vp one an other: and they shal hate one an other. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=11}}† And many {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ There were in the people false Prophetes, as among you also shal be lying Maisters, which shal bring in Sectes of perdition. ''2. Pet. 2''.}}∷ falseprophets shal rise: and shal seduce many. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=12}}† And because {{sup|‖}} iniquitie shal abound: the charitie of many shal waxe cold. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=13}}† But he that shal perseuêre to the end, he shal be saued.⊣ {{verse|chapter=24|verse=14}}† And this Gospel of the kingdom {{sup|‖}} shal be preached in the vvhole vvorld, for a testimonie to al nations, and then shal come the consummation.

{{verse|chapter=24|verse=15}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the last Sunday after Pentecost.}}Therfore vvhen you shal see {{sup|‖}} ''the abomination of desolation'', vvhich vvas spoken of by Daniel the Prophet, standing in the holy place (he that readeth, let him vnderstand){{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Dan. 9, 27.''}} {{verse|chapter=24|verse=16}}† then they that are in Ievvrie, let them flee to the mountaines: {{verse|chapter=24|verse=17}}† and he that is on the house-toppe, let him not come dovvne<noinclude>{{rh|||to}}</noinclude>
